scope: TOK-MEM-20261021 lossless opt-in basis-tables/v1: six deterministic JSON payload pairs plus one actual Mailbox fixture, local tiktoken 0.12.0 o200k_base payload tokens and UTF-8 bytes; no total model-token, cash, quality, latency or disk-space claim; deployment v2 on d9fdf9b3 with isolated dispatch-scope delta and explicit v1 regression bridge

implementation.procedure: Independently inspect encoder, strict decoder, actual Mailbox/basis path, immutable consumption and post-encoding budgets. Compare frozen code hashes with executed files and run relevant regressions. Review only the concurrent dispatch_context/default-write-scope delta and its tests; require unchanged measured entry point/encoder/strict/counter/corpus identities to bridge v1 regressions.
implementation.acceptance: Default and old format remain compatible; no loss of fields/values, source/closure/freshness checks precede encoding; unknown schema fails closed.

reference_boundary.procedure: Independently construct expected ordinary objects and compare every table row/column to originals; empty, singleton, long, Unicode and invalid formats/fields/rows/strict-JSON cases. Exercise memory corrections and exact final-payload budgets.
reference_boundary.acceptance: Exact full JSON-value restoration and unchanged input; unsafe/incompatible requests rejected, no hidden truncation.

data_integrity.procedure: Check all configured case IDs, all three formats, input/raw/code/config/environment hashes and source coverage; confirm no omitted negative control or synthetic result represented as private memory.
data_integrity.acceptance: Complete cases and baselines, one deterministic observation per case, full payload retained; current actual source identity bound.

numerical_sanity.procedure: Recompute complete UTF-8 byte lengths and actual o200k token counts from raw payload strings, compare deltas for every case without aggregation.
numerical_sanity.acceptance: Finite nonnegative integer counts and exact arithmetic; short-32 smaller than both baselines. Small or no-gain cases reported.

measurement_validity.procedure: Check pinned tokenizer version/rank/pattern/special identity, identical decoded values and serialization across pairs, full payload including marker/column overhead, no timing/QA inference.
measurement_validity.acceptance: Deterministic payload-only token scope; exclude no encoded field, preserve grow cases; no end-to-end extrapolation.

reproducibility.procedure: Independent rerun of fixed measurement and regressions into verifier-owned runtime directory; compare all deterministic fixtures and raw payload/counts. Mailbox timestamps may vary, compare within each current pair and verify counts independently. Reuse the independently accepted v1 52-test and property observations only with exact key-source/config/tokenizer/corpus equivalence; freshly run dispatch and Linux strict regressions.
reproducibility.acceptance: Six deterministic cases reproduce byte-for-byte; actual Mailbox pair restores exactly and its counts match independent recount; environment and limitations explicit.
